svg.aria-label: Temporalis and masseter (right lateral view) — 颞肌与咬肌（右侧面观）

text.aria-label: Temporalis and masseter (right lateral view) — 颞肌与咬肌（右侧面观）
Posterior fibres run almost horizontally — 后部纤维近水平
Anterior fibres run vertically — 前部纤维垂直
Zygomatic arch (tendon passes deep to it) — 颧弓（肌腱从其深面经过）
text.tspan: Zygomatic arch (tendon passes deep to it)
颧弓（肌腱从其深面经过）

text.aria-label: Deep part (behind, fibres vertical) — 深部（靠后，纤维垂直）
Superficial part (fibres run down and back) — 浅部（纤维向后下方）
text.tspan: Superficial part (fibres run down and back)

text.aria-label: Origin → insertion — 起点 → 止点
Origin: temporal fossa below the inferior temporal line, and temporal fascia — 起点：颞下线以下的颞窝和颞筋膜
text.tspan: Origin: temporal fossa below the inferior temporal line, and temporal fascia
起点：颞下线以下的颞窝和颞筋膜

text.aria-label: Insertion: coronoid process and anterior border of the ramus — 止点：冠突和下颌支前缘
text.tspan: Insertion: coronoid process and anterior border of the ramus
止点：冠突和下颌支前缘

text.aria-label: Origin: zygomatic bone and zygomatic arch — 起点：颧骨和颧弓
text.tspan: Origin: zygomatic bone and zygomatic arch

text.aria-label: Insertion: lateral surface of the ramus, the angle and the coronoid process — 止点：下颌支外侧面、下颌角和冠突
text.tspan: Insertion: lateral surface of the ramus, the angle and the coronoid process
止点：下颌支外侧面、下颌角和冠突
Schematic; pathway and layers are simplified.
解剖示意；走行与层次经过简化。
